metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a Stiff Neck (RELIEF IN SECONDS!)
metadataRaw.description:
Woke up with a stiff, achy neck? Struggling to turn your head without discomfort? Dr. Rowe demonstrates four simple exercises to quickly release tight muscles—the leading cause of neck stiffness.

Each technique targets different muscle groups, so try them all to find what works best for you. Some may provide relief in as little as 30 seconds!

Don't let neck pain slow you down—watch now and start feeling better fast!
